summary: Maple Hill (East Lake) lookout in Mackinac County, Michigan; built late 1930s per a 1966 newspaper; 1966 plan to keep it for emergency detection; no source describes it today.

events.note: Newspaper item reports aerial fire detection replacing three Mackinac County towers (Moran, Maple Hill, Daggett); plans at the time were to keep Moran and Maple Hill for emergency detection. The same item dates the three towers to the late 1930s.

notes_for_editor: One source only: a 1966 Evening News item reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page. The build date is given only as the late 1930s, so no built event is recorded. No source found on the tower's fate after 1966 or on the site today; two web searches for a Maple Hill lookout in Mackinac County returned nothing relevant. The 1966 keep-for-emergency-detection plan is a 1966 plan, not a later fact. Do not confuse with the Maple Hill tower in Tioga County, PA. Lead for a later pass: Hiawatha National Forest records office and Michigan DNR fire-control records from the 1960s.
